name: Two named reds in the full suite: constants.py says 24 / test wants 40, and the dockerhub token test still patches subprocess.run
description:
Owner: IT team. Found by the QA gate on shift 7 (2026-11-19), full `pytest` run: 1531 passed / 2 failed / 1 skipped (140 s), junit `.pytest_cache/qa_junit.xml`.

Both failures are contract drift inside the **uncommitted** working tree — not environment noise, not stale committed tests.

## Red 1 — tests/test_constants.py::test_max_budget_is_larger_than_agile
- Fails: `assert constants.MAX_MAX_ITERATIONS == 40` → `where 24 = constants.MAX_MAX_ITERATIONS`.
- Code (dirty, +19/-4): `codx/junior/ai/smol/constants.py:311` `MAX_MAX_ITERATIONS = 24`, `:312` `MAX_MAX_TOOL_CALLS = 6`.
- Test (dirty, +13/-4): `tests/test_constants.py:112-113` wants `40` and `8`.
- The number is a PRODUCT DECISION (max-tier budget; relates to card 3d38db45). Pick one value and make code + test + any profile `effort` block agree in the same change.
- Acceptance: `qa_run_tests(paths=["tests/test_constants.py"])` → 0 failed. Do not lower the assertion just to pass; if 24 is the new intended budget, change the test deliberately and say so in the commit message.

## Red 2 — tests/test_dockerhub_token.py::test_publish_hands_the_vault_value_to_the_script
- Fails: `assert seen.get(hub.TOKEN_NAME) == FAKE_VALUE` → `None == 'unit-test-value-not-a-real-token'`, `where None = {}.get('DOCKERHUB_TOKEN')` (captured env is empty ⇒ the capture callable never ran).
- Cause: the test patches `hub.subprocess.run` (line ~196); the dirty `codx/junior/tools/dockerhub_tools.py` (+82/-19) now calls `subprocess.Popen` (~line 641) so the publish log can be streamed to a file. `tests/test_dockerhub_token.py` was NOT updated in the same change.
- The product fix is present: `token = _token()` → `env[TOKEN_NAME] = token` (`dockerhub_tools.py:617-622`). So this is a stale test, not a product regression — but the vault→child-env contract is unverified until the test patches the right symbol.
- Acceptance: re-point the monkeypatch at `hub.subprocess.Popen` and read `env` from its kwargs; `qa_run_tests(paths=["tests/test_dockerhub_token.py"])` → 13 passed / 0 failed. Never delete or skip the test.

## Done when
`qa_run_tests(paths=["tests/test_constants.py","tests/test_dockerhub_token.py"])` → 0 failed, and then `qa_review_changes(scope="all")` no longer reports `tests.failed`.
